access_channel — 2D color op

• Data kinds: color → image

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "access_channel", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: access_channel (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

*The figure is the actual output on a synthetic 128×128 input. Left: input, right: output. Point clouds are drawn as a top-down scatter (brightness = z), 1-D series as a line plot, volumes as the maximum-intensity projection along z, videos as the middle frame, complex images as magnitude; return values that are not pictures are shown as the values themselves.*

Usage

Extracts a single channel from a multichannel image. Corresponds to HALCON's `access_channel` (accesses a single channel of a multichannel image).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

a でチャンネル番号を 0(R)/1(G)/2(B) の 3 通りから選ぶ

（`min(2, int(a * 3))`）。b は未使用。
